animation: CSS steps(4,end), presentation only; no gameplay RNG or state
processing: Sprites only: crop registered columns and actor rows, common per-actor bounds/scale/feet, nearest-neighbour128pixel packing and4x enlargement; no repainting. See build.py. Cartography is a read-only SVG clone, not a generated bitmap.
geography_note: Uses the actual current campaign map renderer; does not change gameplay terrain, routes or state.

unselected_art.reason: Rejected for inaccurate islands and city positions; never used by runtime

cartography.mode: Read-only deep clone of the actual latest game renderer, after it is available
cartography.coordinates: Exact original viewBox, city IDs and child use coordinates; same terrain image and route geometry
cartography.fallback: None: no stale raster or generated map
cartography.styling: Current map composited inside the existing bright16:9panorama; unified1.35x horizontal cover projection, warm pixel palette andgoldcityfill/edgefade; all original logical map coordinates preserved
cartography.foreground: game/assets/loading/cover.png, old fortress art only; upper black area masked
